LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.IsBinaryPrefixCod: A binary word assignment c is a prefix code if, whenever c(a) is a prefix of c(b), the labels a and b coincide. In particular distinct labels receive distinct words.
For any binary prefix code c on a finite label set, its codeword lengths satisfy the Kraft inequality ∑ₐ 2^(−length(c(a))) ≤ 1.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.exists_isBinaryPr: If natural-number lengths ℓ(a) on a finite label set satisfy ∑ₐ 2^(−ℓ(a)) ≤ 1, there is a binary prefix code with length exactly ℓ(a) at each label.
